name: Voxelization by Rasterization
definition: A deferred shading technique for real-time ambient occlusion in dynamic scenes that combines object-space voxelization with screen-space filtering to include geometry outside the view frustum or occluded by front objects.
summary: Voxelization by Rasterization generates a 3D occupancy grid by rasterizing scene geometry into a 3D texture, differing from screen-space techniques by operating in object space to capture occluded geometry.
